sentences.text:
Though this matter has come up for admission,
with consent of learned counsel for parties, it is taken up for hearing.
2. This appeal is filed against the judgment and award dated 10.08.2022 passed by the Senior Civil Judge and MACT, Humnabad, in MVC No.240 of 2020.
3. The injured claimant, aged 22 years, doing labour work met with an accident on 27.12.2019 and filed a claim application claiming compensation of Rs.15,00,000/- with interest.

The Tribunal,
considering the entire evidence on record, granted the compensation of Rs.96,189/- with interest at the rate of 6 percent per annum from the date of petition till realisation.
NC: 2025:KHC-K:7476 HC-KAR 4.
Heard the arguments of both sides.

5. In the appeal, it is stated that as per Exhibit P5, the petitioner sustained the following injuries:
" Diffused cerebral edema Multiple face zone facture "
6.

As per Exhibit P8-CT face scan, the petitioner sustained eight injuries, which are as under:
" 1. Fracture of anterior and posterior wall of bilateral frontal sinus.
2. Fracture of roof, medial wall, supra orbital ridge and lateral wall of left orbit.
3. Fracture of roof and medial wall of right orbit.

Veeresh vs Prashanth And Anr on 4 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110667004/
2 4. Fracture of nasal bone and bony nasal septum.

5. Fracture of roof, medial, lateral and anterior wall of right maxillary sinus.
6. Fracture of hard palate.
7.
Fracture of roof, anterior and medial wall of left orbit.
8. Fracture of bilateral pterygoid fossa, medial pterygoid plate on right side and lateral peterygoid plate on left side.

"
NC: 2025:KHC-K:7476 HC-KAR 7.
The petitioner-claimant was admitted in the hospital as an inpatient from 01.01.2020 to 06.01.2020 and incurred Rs.1,12,060/- towards medical expenses.

But the Tribunal has granted meager amount, and no amounts are granted for pain and suffering, loss of amenities, loss of income during the laid up period and transportation and extra nourishment attendant charges.
8. Though as per the wound certificate, the petitioner sustained only one fracture, but as per the CT scan, he sustained several fractures.
The petitioner has not examined the doctor before the Tribunal.
The claimant filed this appeal on 28.02.2023 and MVC No.240 of 2020 was disposed upon 10.08.2022.
Though the claimant has mentioned the above fracture injuries under the appeal grounds, but has not examined the doctor before the Tribunal.
Therefore, this Court finds that it is just and reasonable to remand the matter to the Tribunal with a direction to dispose of the matter by giving reasonable opportunity to both sides.

9. In the result, the following order is passed:
NC: 2025:KHC-K:7476 HC-KAR (i) The appeal is allowed.

(ii) The matter is remanded back to the Tribunal with a specific direction to grant reasonable opportunity to both sides for adducing evidence and for arguments and to decide the matter on merits, by duly considering the entire evidence on record.
(iii) However, the claimant is not entitled for interest from 28.02.2023 to till today.
(iv) Registry is directed to send the records in ten days.
(v) Both the parties are directed to appear before the Tribunal on 22.12.2025.
